Transaction processing system (TPS)?
An information system that records and processes the routine day-to-day transactions of an organisation, in real time or in batches.
Management information system (MIS)?
An information system that summarises data from transaction systems into regular, exception and on-demand reports for middle managers.
Decision support system (DSS)?
An interactive information system that uses data and models to help managers make semi-structured and unstructured decisions, for example through what-if analysis.
Expert system?
A computer system that emulates the decision-making of a human expert in a specific domain using a knowledge base and an inference engine.
Knowledge base?
The part of an expert system that stores facts and rules gathered from human experts.
Inference engine?
The part of an expert system that applies the rules in the knowledge base to the facts supplied in order to reach conclusions.
